from collections import OrderedDict

def fetch_playlists(is_public):
    playlists=OrderedDict()
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        resp=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, query='', is_public=is_public, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=None)
        if not resp:
            break
        for pl in resp:
            playlists[pl['playlist_id']]={'playlist_id':pl['playlist_id'],'title':pl['title'],'is_public':pl['is_public'],'song_ids':list(pl.get('song_ids',[]))}
        page_index+=1
    return playlists

pl_public=fetch_playlists(True)
pl_private=fetch_playlists(False)
all_playlists={**pl_public,**{pid:pl for pid,pl in pl_private.items() if pid not in pl_public}}

playlist_song_ids=set()
for p in all_playlists.values():
    playlist_song_ids.update(p['song_ids'])

# Fetch release dates for all unique song ids present in playlists
song_release={}
for sid in sorted(playlist_song_ids):
    sd=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    song_release[sid]=sd.get('release_date')

# Target songs for playlist removal: release year > 2021

# also compute target library songs released after 2021 among library songs

    resp=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit,query='',sort_by=None)
    if not resp:
        break
    lib_songs.extend(resp)
    page_index+=1

lib_song_ids=set([s['song_id'] for s in lib_songs])
TARGET_LIBRARY={sid for sid in lib_song_ids if song_release.get(sid) and datetime.fromisoformat(song_release[sid]).year>2021}
# For library songs not in playlists, release_date isn't fetched above; fetch those too
missing=lib_song_ids - set(song_release.keys())
for sid in sorted(missing):
    sd=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    song_release[sid]=sd.get('release_date')
    if song_release[sid] and datetime.fromisoformat(song_release[sid]).year>2021:
        TARGET_LIBRARY.add(sid)

print('library_songs_count',len(lib_song_ids))

print('target_library_song_ids_list',sorted(TARGET_LIBRARY))

# confirm overlap
print('overlap_target_library_and_playlist',len(TARGET_LIBRARY & TARGET_PLAYLIST))

def fetch_playlists(is_public):
    playlists=OrderedDict()
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        resp=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, query='', is_public=is_public, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=None)
        if not resp:
            break
        for pl in resp:
            playlists[pl['playlist_id']]={'playlist_id':pl['playlist_id'],'title':pl['title'],'is_public':pl['is_public'],'song_ids':list(pl.get('song_ids',[]))}

pl_public=fetch_playlists(True)
